plan.scope: Evaluate a funded halving round on a common validation row, skipping only grades that cannot change the exact shortlist. Spend saved lookups on further full rounds. Keep the same halving rungs and independent qualification as the simple control. At the prior low ceiling, sweep every funded integer cap with four and, where available, eight challengers. Select a new setting on each calibration fold, check eager parity with reuse disabled, and replay only the selected setting on the audit fold. The expanded CPO menu replaces the old setting only if calibration improves its pass total or its paid cost at equal passes.
